_comment: CCV-L23's declared feedback for ooe_sched (OA's rulings on TI-38, revs 187 and 191; DA's alignment amendment, 2026-10-23): the one-cycle select loop. The request and ready registers (stage 03) and their enables read the grant register (04) and its lead (05) back, the loop V-65's same-cycle confirmation needs; their frames are OI-45's. Each read's offset is the stages its tag lies past its reader's. u_select gnt/hold/rhold (OA 509 (3a), OA 516).

isg_cq02h.why: issued as ooe_rs's rule reads it: the grant leaving now, whose next value the request register feeds through the select (OA's rev 187)

rq_en_cq02h.why: the request register's enable: a grant leaving, and its own change bit, each fed back from the register it clocks (OA's rev 187)

ready_en_cq02h.why: the ready register's enable: a grant some row depends on left at the last edge, through the select and the grant register (OA's rev 191)

cok_nx_cq02h.why: OA's response OI-141 (OA tab, 2026-11-13): MA-5's credit flag. The counter is a stage-04 register updated by the grants that leave it; the flag select reads is a stage-03 one, so A reaches it only through the select loop, as isg/rq_en/ready_en

u_select.gnt_cq03h.why: select's mask of last cycle's grants (OA 509 (3a)): the grant register gnt_cq04h, read back at 03 a cycle on, keeps an entry granted then from being granted again before its issued bit lands. A missing mask regrants (no_regrant; control regrant).

u_select.hold_cq03h.why: the ret hold (OA rev 293, OA 509 (3a)): a ret granted last cycle (gnt_cq04h over rtq_cq04h) holds this cycle's branch and call grants. ret_holds (OA 510): no branch or call is granted the cycle after a ret's grant; control no-hold removes select's ret hold under CCV_CHECK_SCHED.

u_select.rhold_cq03h.why: RA-17's idle-R force, closed through the grant register (OA 512, OI-230): u_select's grant at 03 is held in gnt_cq04h; R granted last cycle (gnt over rrq) extends the run rnx, and the force copies fcp_cq04h take it with the migration a cycle ahead; select reads fcp as rhold at 03 and holds R's footprints off. A force that comes a cycle late lets an idle R run past idle_r_k (idle_r; control no-force).
